description: Two-parameter sweep of a polarization_control.py Project (--base: its nominal/project.json or the Project written with polarization_threshold.json). hwp_turn turns the waveplate HWP about its own optical axis (local +Z, through its origin) by the value relative to its current angle; wavelength sets the source wavelength. The sample outcome is decided by transmitted_power only ("targets"); output_azimuth is recorded too. The default retarder is characterized for 1000-1060 nm, so every 1064 nm sample is OUT_OF_MODEL (MODEL_WAVELENGTH_OUTSIDE_BAND) whatever its target statuses. Feasible: transmitted_power PASS and in model scope; best: largest transmitted power.
